card.name: Words introducing cardiovascular outcome endpoints
card.fires_on: Short linking words right before a named clinical outcome, such as 'defined as', 'To reduce the risk', 'composite of', or 'all-cause'. Also the start of 'Sub' before 'sequent' or 'populations' in dosing sections.

modes.label: Endpoint lead-in words
modes.description: A small word like as, of, all, reduce or the that comes just before an outcome such as CV death, MI or risk of decline.

modes.label: Sub at start of heading words
modes.description: The piece 'Sub' that begins words like subsequent or subpopulations in dosing headings.
